attempted_axis: Full side-decomposition of pbFrameMode's real-389 MIXED residual, then three source-shape axes. FINDING: the residual is NOT the six --ops opcode clusters prior runs chased -- those are ~9 instructions; the other ~380 real diffs are OPERAND-ONLY rows that --ops cannot show. One of them was a real bug: the file-local PbTplA/PbTplB/PbTplC view structs declared their members as PBGSReg, a union over u64 (align 8), while their 4-byte _padNN gaps were sized for a 4-aligned 8-byte member. Every member after the first pad was therefore pushed off its named offset (PbTplA m0C 0x0C->0x10, m18 0x18->0x20, m24 0x24->0x30, m30 0x30->0x40, m38 0x38->0x48, m44 0x44->0x58; PbTplC m28 0x28->0x30). Retyping those members to the file's existing P8 {u32 a; u32 b;} (size 8, align 4) reproduces every named offset exactly. Verified against the target at two independent sites: line 646 colclamp<-m38 target reads 56/60 (we read 72/76), line 648 dthe<-m44 target reads 68/72 (we read 88/92); both became byte-identical '=' rows after the fix. The old form was also an out-of-bounds read: tplA1 is u8[88] and m44 resolved to 88..95.

attributes.residual: real 391 after the fix (from 389), fuzzy 96.9885 (from 96.9635). Decomposition of what remains, all re-derived this run from aligned views, NOT inherited labels: (A) COUNT GAP = exactly one extra 'mr' @824 and nothing else -- the --ops multiset is 'ours-only: -1 mr' with no cancelling deltas, so the DB-precedent hypothesis of hidden +2/-1/-1 is REFUTED for this function. Target does 'slwi r8,r0,6' straight into the long-lived r8 and feeds 'subfic r9,r8,256' from it; we do 'slwi r0,r0,6' + 'mr r8,r0' + 'subfic r9,r0,256'. Semantically identical, pure regalloc. The single-web source form is VETOED by v3 (389->459). (B) 4x conversion-temp clusters @b4/@19c/@284/@36c, one per switch arm (case 3/4/5/6), stride 58 insns. slotdiff --all: frame 864/864 IDENTICAL, all 38 slots present BOTH sides, only two use-count deltas (768 T7/O5, 776 T5/O7). Four anonymous 8-byte temps at 760/768/776/784 serve two roles: stw+stw+lfd (signed int->double magic, xoris+0x43300000) and stfd+lwz+4 (fctiwz double->int). TARGET groups by ROLE -- both build temps are the adjacent pair {776,784} and both conv temps the adjacent pair {768,760} in case 3, mirrored to builds {768,760}/convs {776,784} in cases 4-6. OURS groups by EXPRESSION -- expr1 takes {768 build, 760 conv}, expr2 takes {784 build, 776 conv}. Equivalently: applying the single transposition 768<->776 (with partners 772<->780) to our stream fixes ALL FOUR build sites exactly, leaving only a within-site order swap of the two conv temps. Axis of named f32 intermediates is dead (above). (C) two expression RE-ASSOCIATION seams @6a4 (o1_display, src line 523-525) and @76c (o2_display, src line 536-539). At BOTH, our source ALREADY carries the target's association and MWCC re-associates it away: @6a4 source is 'f1 + (FA4 + FAC)' and target keeps the parenthesised group ('add r9,r11,r9' then '+f1') while we emit 'FA4 + (FAC + f1)'; @76c source is 'f1 + f2 + FA4 + FAC + 1' and target binds ((((f1+f2)+FA4)+FAC)+1) while we emit ((((f2+FA4)+FAC)+1)+f1), i.e. f1 added LAST. So the lever is NOT term order (v3 already measured the f1/f2 swap at 391) but suppressing re-association, and v3 measured the (FA4+FAC) temp hoist at 471 with the local cluster byte-UNCHANGED -- MWCC re-associates through the temp too. (D) two stw pair-order seams @bd4 (dthe) and @cf8 (clr_xyz2b): after this run's offset fix the loads match exactly and only the store ORDER of the 8-byte P8 copy differs (target stores the high word first, we store low first). NOT probed this run: the access-cast type (P8 vs u64) at the 26 copy sites is the untried lever and is the recommended next axis.
